partners.diseaseBName: glycogen storage disease due to phosphoglycerate mutase deficiency
partners.mechanism_chain: PFKM (HGNC:9004) —DISRUPTS→ Glycolysis (KEGG:00010); Glycolysis (KEGG:00010) —DECREASES→ 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate (CHEBI:17396); 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate (CHEBI:17396) —LEADS_TO→ Muscle weakness (HP:0001324); PGAM2 (HGNC:9000) —DISRUPTS→ Glycolysis (KEGG:00010); Glycolysis (KEGG:00010) —DECREASES→ 3-Phosphoglycerate (CHEBI:17539); 3-Phosphoglycerate (CHEBI:17539) —LEADS_TO→ Exercise intolerance (HP:0009124). Loss-of-function mutations in PFKM (GSD VII) and PGAM2 (GSD due to PGAM2 deficiency) both impair the glycolytic pathway. PFKM deficiency leads to accumulation of 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate, while PGAM2 deficiency leads to reduced production of 3-Phosphoglycerate. Both downstream metabolic disruptions ultimately converge on cellular energy deficit and associated muscle phenotypes like weakness and exercise intolerance.

falsification.text: Identification of pathogenic variants in PFKM or PGAM2 in individuals diagnosed with the *other* disease, and demonstration that these variants do not segregate with the phenotype, would falsify this hypothesis. partners.mechanism_chain: PFKM (HGNC:9009) —DISRUPTS→ Glycolysis (REACT:R-HSA-5693370); Glycolysis (REACT:R-HSA-5693370) —DECREASES→ ATP (CHEBI:15422); ATP (CHEBI:15422) —LEADS_TO→ Hemolytic anemia (HP:0001874); PKLR (HGNC:9005) —DISRUPTS→ Glycolysis (REACT:R-HSA-5693370); PKLR (HGNC:9005) —LEADS_TO→ Hemolytic anemia (HP:0001874). Loss-of-function mutations in PFKM (encoding phosphofructokinase-1) impair glycolysis, leading to reduced ATP production and hemolytic anemia in GSD VII. Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in PKLR (encoding pyruvate kinase) also disrupt glycolysis, decreasing ATP production and causing hemolytic anemia in pyruvate kinase hyperactivity. Both diseases converge on the disruption of glycolysis and subsequent ATP depletion as a shared mechanism leading to hemolytic anemia.
